about_the_game:
Duskmarch Demo – A Taste of Dice-Based Fantasy RPG

Step into the world of Duskmarch with this demo, a dice-based RPG that blends tactical combat and immersive storytelling, optimized for mobile. Create a hero, explore a limited fantasy world, and fight enemies by rolling dice to shape your fate.

What’s Included in the Demo

  • Create Your Hero: Roll dice to determine your character’s stats and choose an archetype—cunning rogue, mighty warrior, or mystical spellcaster. Reach up to level 2, unlocking new skills or spells for early challenges.

  • Explore a Limited World: Navigate a 2D global map by spending movement points to visit locations and unlock access to the first castle. These locations feature interactive stories, dialogues, and battles in eerie forests and ancient ruins. Inside the first castle, explore half of its available areas to find rewards and continue your journey.

  • Engage in Tactical Combat: Fight in turn-based battles where initiative sets the action order. Move across dynamic battlefields, swap weapons, and use abilities or spells to defeat enemies. Roll a 20-sided die with physics-based visuals for attacks, and watch damage dice roll across the screen. Earn experience and loot as you triumph.

  • Unravel Early Stories: Discover location-based tales with unique events and mysteries. Make dialogue choices with attribute checks to shape outcomes—negotiate peace or dive into combat. The first castle offers early stories with limited areas to explore and chances to uncover rewards.

Demo Highlights

  • Dice-Based Mechanics: Roll for stats, attacks, and damage with satisfying physics.

  • Character Customization: Build your hero with archetypes and skills up to level 2.

  • Strategic Exploration: Travel the map to unlock the first castle and explore half of its areas.

  • Tactical Combat: Plan moves in turn-based battles with dice rolls.

  • Immersive Stories: Shape early narratives through choices and skill checks.

This demo offers a taste of Duskmarch’s core mechanics and story. Roll the dice and start your adventure today!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD Phenom II X4 965
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: None
pc_requirements.recommended:

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: None
